snippet.title: Shin Nippon Pro Wrestling Toukon Retsuden (PLAYSTATION)
snippet.description:
Many people probably nevered heard of the series, but this series for the playstation loosk pretty good on its own (too bad the AI is just not there)

Because this was only a Japan release, it goes by Japan rules, so no flashy holds or submits, just good frame by frame entertainment (slow,but good)

I'll be adding the other 2 series during the week.
